snippet.title: Expanding my Roguelike with RANDOMISED Dungeons | Chemical Combat Devlog 2
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, it's time for another devlog on Chemical Combat. During my second week in the competition, I improved the game loop by adding procedurally generated dungeons, new enemy types, and coins which can be spent on player upgrades.

🎮 Come wishlist Chemical Combat on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3490250/Chemical_Combat/


💬 Join my discord server here!
https://discord.com/invite/NxDSW65sUY

🙋‍♂️ Support the channel by subscribing!
https://www.youtube.com/@sigmoiddev

🎬 Check out the rest of the devlogs!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdCLXFnLGVkDi819PJWZBBoNhcDzZCGev


📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Intro
0:21 - Dungeons (BSP)
2:00 - Major Changes
3:06 - Lighting & Minimap
3:26 - Coins & Upgrades
3:54 - Enemy Types
4:16 - Result & Plans
5:06 - Outro


🎶 Music:
massobeats - ocean | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=McKZg6kowQ4 https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/ocean
massobeats - stroll | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B5YlDkIIQjE https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/stroll
 

🔗 Credits:
All Icons by Freepik on FlatIcon https://www.flaticon.com/
All Gifs from https://tenor.com/
Most Memes from https://reddit.com/


📱Software:
Recording: OBS Studio 🎥
Editing: DaVinci Resolve🎬
Engine: Unity 🕹️
IDE: Visual Studio Code 💻
Theme: Rainglow - Rainbow 🌈
Pixel Art: Aseprite 🖼️
Planning: Obsidian🗒️
